correctness.rationale: The four independent descendants give f_p(x)=1-(1-p)(1-x^2)^2. For a periodic nonunit fixed orbit of the k-fold composition the exact telescoping identity 1=prod(1-p_j)prod((1-x_j)(1+x_j)^2) holds. h(x)<=32/27 with equality only at 1/3, so the critical product and its unique constant equality exception follow. A nonunit fixed point cannot exist below the threshold; monotone continuous period iteration from any q then tends to 1. At constant p=5/32 the q=0 orbit increases only to 1/3. The numerical two-profile comparison was independently reproduced at 1 versus ~0.2661867069; finite observations are not the all-period proof.
